authority.rule: Enumerate money for every route before using money to rank any route.
authority.anti_filter_rule: No route may disappear because its compensation or funding is unknown, low, awkward, conditional, or unpublished.
authority.coverage_target: 149/149 census routes accounted for by an economics state.

state_semantics.VERIFIED_NUMERIC: Current source exposes a numeric stipend/salary/floor/range.
state_semantics.PUBLISHED_NONCASH: Current source exposes tuition waiver or other material non-cash value but no monthly salary/stipend amount.
state_semantics.NEGOTIABLE_UNDISCLOSED: Current posting explicitly says compensation is negotiable / not numerically disclosed.
state_semantics.CONDITIONAL_PROGRAM: Funding exists but eligibility, competition, nationality/status, advisor match, or award decision is conditional.
state_semantics.HISTORICAL_REVERIFY: A prior/current-adjacent amount exists but the exact 116/current-cycle amount needs re-verification.
state_semantics.SEARCH_PENDING: Route remains in the universe; economics has not yet been source-locked.
state_semantics.IDENTITY_GAP: The original machine census counted the route but the exact row identity was lost with the transient attachment; preserve denominator without inventing the row.

coverage.phd_route_accounting_method: Each exact PhD route inherits the current funding bundle of its institution/program family until route-specific funding is recovered.
coverage.employment_route_accounting_method: Each named job route inherits the current compensation state of its exact posting/employer family; missing numeric disclosure is retained as a state, not treated as zero.
coverage.coverage_rule: UNKNOWN IS A RESULT, NOT AN OMISSION.

before_rank: Every one of the 149 census routes must have an economics state.
Numeric amount, tuition waiver, duration, certainty, eligibility gate, and source date are separate fields.
Negotiable/unpublished salary remains a route; it is not treated as zero and not dropped.
Institution-wide or national scholarships must not be silently promoted to guaranteed route-specific funding.
Actual admission funding letters and job offers supersede planning estimates.
execution_contract.delta_research_priority: Research debt is ordered by missing economics evidence, not by fit. SEARCH_PENDING rows stay in scope until checked or explicitly shown unpublished.
execution_contract.ranking_gate: Money-weighted ranking may start only after this economics census is attached to the complete route universe.
